LightningComponentBundle.description: Configurable alerts ribbon. Two sources: rule-driven alerts evaluated against the current record (Record Page), and static alerts always shown (Home / App Page friendly). 4 severities, 3 visual variants, 2 densities, optional sticky-on-scroll behavior.

property.name: rulesCsv
property.label: Rule-driven alerts (one per line)
property.description: Format: '<field><op><value>|<severity>|<icon>|<message>|<ctaLabel>|<ctaUrl>'. Ops: = != > < >= <= contains startsWith endsWith isBlank isNotBlank. Severity: info|success|warning|error. Icon and CTA optional.

property.name: visualStyle
property.label: Visual style
property.description: 'inline' (default) renders alerts directly above the page content. 'card' wraps them in a lightning-card chrome with a title and a count pill.

property.name: alertVariant
property.label: Alert variant
property.description: 'banner' (soft pastel + accent border-left), 'solid' (saturated background), 'minimal' (white background, accent bar only).

property.name: density
property.label: Layout density
property.description: 'comfortable' allows wrap. 'compact' truncates the message with ellipsis.

property.name: cardTitle
property.label: Card title (override)
property.description: Used only when visualStyle = card. Leave empty for the dictionary default.

property.name: cardIcon
property.label: Card icon
property.description: SLDS icon name. Used only when visualStyle = card.

property.name: stickyOnScroll
property.label: Sticky on scroll
property.description: When ON, the ribbon stays pinned to the top of the page on scroll.
